dlg.snib.first.0.wants: you gone, and to look important
dlg.snib.first.0.note: 'Oi! OI!' squeaky shouting. Self-important 'Foreman's orders!'. A pause; proud: 'Snib is the foreman.' Fussy. 'Snib does not know who.' then, deflating, 'Snib knows exactly who.' Then 'What do you want? Quick.'

dlg.snib.ember.0.note: 'KNOW' stressed. Babbling the chain of who pays who faster and faster. A pause; panicked: 'Snib did not say any of this.'

dlg.snib.poison.0.note: Dismissive. Then the Boss's fervour quoted, 'DOWN' stressed, eyes wide. Callous last line.

dlg.snib.move.0.note: Thinking: '...The sinkhole.' Then excited, shouting orders: 'Snib has had an idea!' proud.

dlg.snib.lamp.0.note: 'LAMP' awestruck. 'SPIT' stressed. A pause; frightened denial. Then shouting orders.

dlg.snib.bribed.0.note: Terribly acted sorrow. 'SO sad.' over the top.

dlg.snib.pipelads.0.note: Flat and quiet, unusually, about going blind and the warm slurry. 'Snib got promoted.' hollow. Then scared and loud: 'Snib wants you to LEAVE.'

dlg.snib.what.0.note: Proud 'Slurry!'. 'Stream is very obliging.' pleased. Then quieter: he's never needed to KNOW.

dlg.survivor.first.0.intent: a lampling broken by what he saw
dlg.survivor.first.0.note: A dry, close whisper, rocking. 'MOVED' a hissed burst. Repeats 'Grimtunnel says' like a prayer he no longer believes.

dlg.survivor.what.0.note: Whispered. 'There is always another.' 'Still lit. Still lit.' haunted. Then a frantic pleading whisper: take the map.

dlg.jory.first.0.wants: someone to believe it wasn't wolves
dlg.jory.first.0.note: Short sentences, unsteady. 'I— thank you.' A small laugh-sob about Uncle. Then urgent, quiet: the clerk in violet. 'And they were waiting.' a shiver.

dlg.jory.hub.0.note: 'I'm all right.' Narrator: he isn't. Bitter about Uncle.

dlg.jory.crates.0.note: A list. A boy's bravado on 'every rut'. A pause; quietly frightened question.

dlg.jory.truth.0.note: Narrator: one laugh. Numb repetition. Narrator: he stops laughing. '...Uncle knew.' Hurt. 'He told me salt.' breaking.

dlg.jory.truth_knew.0.note: Narrator for the nodding. 'Right. Right.' Then the family line, sick and honest.

dlg.jory.truth_ask.0.note: 'I will.' Narrator: he doesn't move. 'I will.' smaller.

dlg.jory.salt.0.note: Narrator: it goes out of his face. 'Salt. Right.' relieved and young. 'Thanks.'

dlg.tam.first.0.note: A child's voice, rushing. 'Three of them.' 'Nobody believes me.' sulky. A pause; small and hopeful: 'You believe me?'

dlg.tam.story.0.note: Run-on, joined with 'and', the exact details in order. 'like Gran's' matter-of-fact. 'Pa says stay in town. I stayed in town.' proud of obeying.

dlg.tam.farm.0.note: Proud 'Penhale's, that's us.' Quoting Pa gruffly. 'But these ones aren't right.' worried.

dlg.tam.again.0.note: Small and scared. 'Not ever, maybe.' trailing.

dlg.tam.again.1.note: Relief on the arm. Then furious child: 'I SAID it was wolves. Weeks ago.'

dlg.tam.again.2.intent: the hens and Pa's bad word
dlg.tam.again.2.note: Breathless outrage about the hens. Thrilled by the bad word. 'He was smiling, though.'

dlg.tam.again.3.note: Very quiet. 'He always comes in.' a child trying not to cry.

dlg.tam.happy.0.note: Bouncing. 'Did you do it?' in awe.

dlg.tam.cb_killed_greymuzzle.0.note: Awed question; then quieter, sad: was he sick too?

dlg.tam.cb_grey2.0.note: 'Oh.' Repeating Pa. 'Pa says a lot of things.' a child's doubt.

dlg.tam.t_tam.0.note: Fond. The hat said with delight. 'I think she's happy.' hopeful.

dlg.tam.tock.0.note: One long breathless run-on. 'Tock, and then tock' imitated softly. Quoting Pa sleepily. 'but it kept knocking.' quiet and spooked.

cbark.345352a478c0.note: A tolling command, enormous and slow. Each word a bell.

cbark.0f6d39685290.note: 'Oho!' cackling. Gloating; 'Nobody's!' a crow of delight.
